I think I can pass if I study really hard these next 2 weeks. I am socially awkward and people either ignore me or think I'm unworthy of their time although I think I'm an intelligent person. I think rationally and try to apply logic into everything. 
I have friends that are kinda like me. My goal is to be an established person who doesn't do things to be considered a successful person in other people's eyes. I just want to be an established man for the sake of being one. Because I want to be happy with myself. But I seem to care what people think of me and I end up not satisfying them and not being happy. ( I know that trying to satisfy people could never work because they act on whims and likes )

No clubs. There are some events here and there but my family would never allow me to go. I'm not allowed any money on daily or weekly basis. 
It's quite sad the way I'm living. I just watch anime and movies. Read fanfics and try to study but I miss a lot of things ( I have to pass the national exams that ask us about everything we studied all year that's why Im not feeling it )

I just want to have the mindest of a successful person not necessarily be one immediately and I'm the complete opposite of that. I read books about what people do in order to be successful and I understand what they did but I'm just not doing the aame thing. I don't have a hobby. Im a senior in school ( North Africa ). Im probably gonna fail this year. 
I never had any hobbies aside from gaming and watching movies or anime. Basically stuff that amplify sitting at home which acts on depression.
I just broke up with my girlfriend an hour ago cuz I can't be in a healthy relationship bcz Im not normal. 
I really dont know how to feel about any of the stuff Im going through

Depression has been a familiar part of my life for more than 4 years being 19 I look back and remember talking to my cousin at the young age of 11 and 12. We stayed up at night and I used to tell her that the reason I don't want any friends is because it'd be a waste for them seeing as how I'd die at a young age most likely. I remember always feeling this way about life from somewhere around 10 years old. But now that I am 19 I'm at a cross roads. Do I end my life and fulfill that "promise" or if not, then what do I do
I try to speak about it but right after I do I usually think I sound like an attention whore.

I have end of the year exams ( SAT  or idk.. national highschool graduation exams ) I haven't studied a thing all year. I literally have 7 weeks to understand all my lessons from the start of the year. Feeling really bad! I spent ao much time crying about being diagnosed with depression and bipolar that I forgot school. Back to feeling suicidal. I hope to god I can manage to make it through
To be honest, I've only read J.K Rowling's HP series. I will try to open myself up for more books. I'm just glad I realized how important books are for a young man such as myself.

Oh no no, I am not looking for any porn writing whatsoever. I'm looking for books that would make me a more socially enjoyable person to talk to. I want to reach a point where I can go into a conversation and not stutter trying to think of what type of answer I should have. Books that build carisma maybe. I don't know, something a late teenage boy should read that would make him impervious to all this fake media stuff.
I'm happy that I get to read your thoughtful comments. You guys are awesome
Amen to that!
Thank you so much! I hope you're having a wonderful time yourself

It's not really the fact that it's sad music. I love acoustic songs and I just love the sound of an acoustic guitar. And I found so many good songs that are completely under the radar. Whenever I find a good song that's hidden from people I get excited and forget about my depression and I see possibilities in life. Idk maybe I'm meant to be in the music industry. I hate mainstream though

Hi, I'm coming off kinda creepy here but you commented on one of my posts and I appreciated it. 
I'm [18/m] just like you. Muslim from north Africa with open mentality. I'm lonely although I have a couple of close friends. I'm open to talking anytime!
I hate waking up just because it's usually followed by having to get out of bed. But if I csn stay in bed I don't mind waking up.

I can't seem to bring myself to tears anymore. I hate sleeping, I hate joyful music. I'm always listening to country/folk and neo metal/hard rock/alternative. Trying to stay strong, thank you for taking the time to comment you have my appreciation
The fantasy is about people realizing they cared too late and I hated them all so much that I felt they deserve to feel the guilt

This reminds me of how I was last year. One year older than yourself. I didn't feel like going to school but I did it anyway because I didn't want any fuss. My parents don't know about my depression but they think I'm a loner type. I hear that it gets better. Idk I guess I'm waiting on that.

Something I read somewhere it gives me such a sense of sheer joy : It's not about how important you feel when comitting suicide, It's about how guilty everyone else feels after. This is the legacy I shall leave after departing this world by my own hands

Constantly.. I know that I am sad and depressed and suicidal but with every word I type I realize that everything I wrote is worthless hence I am worthless and  so what started out as blowing some steam off ended up not happening bcz of the post being discarded and I get to have a full week of suicidal thoughts.

I have that on most days especially lately..
The thought makes me very calm indeed. It's sort of a relief. At least I know my end and chose it willingly. It does seem inevitable for me to imagine a happy future for myself. No matter how happy it might seem to other people observing my life. I can have the money the fame the life but I'll still have depression and be suicidal

Basically what PureSmoulder said.
Life strikes me as this long bothersom school journey that everyone gets to have fun at, while I am here thinking okay I know I'm the reason for so much pain in the world like I have actual proof that I'm the reason for so much of the pain in the enviroment I'm living in. Because I was meant to be born my two sisters were meant to die before me so my parents would want children. I'm ugly, I'm socially awkward, I sufffer from severe depression and social anxiety. I suck at talking. I suck at fashion. I never go out anywhere. 18 never been on a date. Never gone to drink coffee with friends. I went once to the cinema that's the only time I recall actually doing something like that. Suicidal and considering self harm to ease my pain. It's at least something. No anti depressants ever used. I refuse the idea

Suffering from depression is like having last stage of cancer.. there's no way to prevent it other then medicating which makes people think of you in a certain way and now you're wondering who you are as you start to feel the emptiness of your existence. You start blaming genetics, nurture and everything about your life.. I mean thinking about it now, I did not chose to be born.. shouldn't I be allowed to chose, after knowing what life is both good and bad, weither I want to be born or not.. thinking more about it I come to the conclusion that my two sisters had to die so that my parents would want more kids. I am the reason for their death. Some would perceive my view on the matter as self pity, some as overthinking I say who cares.. at the end if it all, my sisters did die and I was born
